description: This is a PHP class implementation for the admin controller of marketing affiliates in OpenCart. It handles displaying, listing, filtering, and managing affiliate records within the admin interface.

classes.name: Affiliate
classes.description: Controller class for managing affiliate marketing in the admin panel of OpenCart.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main entry point to display the affiliate dashboard or list, preparing data and rendering the view.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns the list of affiliates, setting the language and outputting the view.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Generates and returns the list of affiliate records as a string, applying filters and sorting based on request parameters.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays and handles the affiliate form for adding/editing affiliate information.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving new or existing affiliate data, including validation, permission checking, and updating records. Returns JSON response with success or error message.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected affiliate records after permission validation, and returns JSON response indicating success or failure.

methods.name: calculate
methods.description: Calculates balances or related affiliate data, updating records accordingly. Returns JSON response.

methods.name: csv
methods.description: Exports selected affiliate data as a CSV file for download, with proper headers and formatting.

methods.name: complete
methods.description: Performs finalization tasks for the affiliate management process, such as loading language, processing selected items, updating balances, and returning success messages.

methods.name: report
methods.description: Generates and displays a report of affiliate activity, including pagination, filtering, and data aggregation.

methods.name: getReport
methods.description: Retrieves report data based on request parameters like customer ID, page number, and filters. Compiles report records, store info, and total counts.

methods.name: autocomplete
methods.description: Provides suggestions for filtering by name or email in the affiliate management UI, returning JSON data with matched entries.
